newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin wife hopes for recovery "with God's help".
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin wife hopes for recovery "with God's help".

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin's wife said she was desperate to get a glimpse of her husband after Tuesday's heart operation but hoped he would recover "with God's help".

An emotional Naina Yeltsin told ORT television at the Cardiology Research Centre where Yeltsin underwent a seven-hour operation that she had not yet been allowed to see her husband, who was still recovering from anaesthetic.
"I would love to get a glimpse of him even with one eye," she said. They say the operation went well but we are extremely worried, of course."
She said her 65-year-old husband was very calm as he went into the hospital for the operation, for which he has been waiting around two months.
Naina herself underwent kidney surgery this summer.
